newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Intimate Brands buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Intimate Brands buy repeated.

text.p: Rodman & Renshaw analyst Harry Ikenson Wednesday reiterated his buy recommendation and price target of $28 for Intimate Brands.
-He kept his estimated fiscal 1998 earnings at $1.27 per share and 1999 estimate at $1.48 per share.
Intimate Brands said Wednesday its July 1997 same-store sales rose 7.0 percent from July 1996.
The company consists of Victoria's Secret stores and catalog, Cacique, and Bath & Body Works.

"Overall, (July) sales for the total company were above plan, with all divisions either meeting or exceeding expectations," Ikenson wrote in a research note. "This reinforces our confidence in the company's consistent performance going forward."
-Intimate Brands shares closed Wednesday at 23-7/8, up 1-1/8.
